jobs.how: Each Samsung unit is its own BACnet device, and every indoor unit device uses the same small instance numbers. Write BV 9 inside the indoor unit's device; BO 1 on the gateway device turns everything off.

points.use: Write on/off; check it's writable on the controller
Gateway: write all devices off; check it's writable on the controller

jobs.how: Write the indoor unit mode to MV 14. MV 17 restricts which modes are allowed and MV 18 enables, disables or conditionally allows the local remote controller.

points.use: Write 1-5 = auto/cool/heat/fan/dry; check it's writable on the controller
Write 1-3 = none/cool-only/heat-only; check it's writable on the controller
Write 1-3 = enable/disable/conditional RC; check it's writable on the controller

jobs.how: Write the main setpoint to AV 2; in auto mode the unit has separate cooling and heating setpoints. Limit points need their matching enable BV set True. Instances 27-32 exist in the Advanced point set only.

points.use: Write setpoint, °C; check it's writable on the controller
Write auto-mode cooling setpoint; check it's writable on the controller
Write auto-mode heating setpoint; check it's writable on the controller
Write cooling upper limit; check it's writable on the controller
Write True = apply AV 27; check it's writable on the controller
Write heating lower limit; check it's writable on the controller
Write True = apply AV 28; check it's writable on the controller

jobs.how: Read room temperature on AI 1. Discharge temperature, discharge setpoints and air-quality points are optional and only appear on units that support them.

points.use: Read indoor (room) temperature, °C
Read discharge air temperature
Write discharge cooling setpoint; check it's writable on the controller
Write discharge heating setpoint; check it's writable on the controller
Read PM2.5, μg/m3 (dust sensor units only)
Read air cleanliness level: 2 good to 7 worst

jobs.how: Fan speed and louvre direction are per indoor unit. Wind-Free only exists on units that support it.

points.use: Write 1-5 = auto/low/mid/high/turbo; check it's writable on the controller
Write airflow direction, 8 = swing; check it's writable on the controller
Write Wind-Free on/off; check it's writable on the controller

jobs.how: Watch AI 19 on each indoor unit and AI 2 on the gateway device. A unit that loses communication shows Reliability = COMMUNICATION_FAILURE and the fault flag, and its Present_Value is no longer reliable.

points.use: Read combined indoor and outdoor unit error code
Read True = filter sign on
Write to reset filter sign; check it's writable on the controller
Gateway: read 0 normal, 8 e-stop, 109 DMS comms failed
Gateway: read BACnet error code

jobs.how: Each indoor unit device reports energy and hours of use since a base date and within a period.

points.use: Read kWh since base date
Read minutes of use since base date
Read kWh within period
Read minutes of use within period

checklist: In the DMS2.5 BACnet web pages set the gateway IP, BACnet port (default 47808) and a Network No. (DNET 1-40, default 9) that is different for each gateway on the network.
Pick Basic or Advanced point provision before mapping, because changing it later restarts the DMS and renumbers instances.
Discover the devices and decode each device ID as DNET + CPP code + unit address (941732 = gateway 9, indoor unit 01.01.32) to match devices to units.
On the gateway device read AI 2 (DMS2.5_Status) and confirm it shows 0 = Normal.
On one indoor unit device read AI 1 (AC_RoomTemp), MV 14 (AC_Operation_Mode) and AI 19 (AC_Error_Code).
Test BV 9 (AC_Power) at priority 8, confirm the unit turns on, then turn it off, without sending commands in quick succession.
Set MV 18 (AC_Remocon_Limit) and MV 17 (AC_Mode_Limit) per unit if local control must be restricted.
Map AI 19 on every indoor unit and AI 2 on the gateway as alarms, and resubscribe any COV after the gateway is power cycled.
